title: Errours of the Papists in their distributing of the causes of saluation.

segments.text: And thus is the doctrine of the Church of Rome, surely a very blasphemous doctrine, and no better to be accounted of then as a gallowes set vp for the torture and massacre of mens consciences. And that this may the more manifestly appeare to be so, I will set downe the most principall points of popish doctrine in this case.
